0.long_answer: Ovarian cancer is often mistaken for irritable bowel syndrome (IBS) because the early symptoms of ovarian cancer, such as abdominal bloating, changes in bowel habits, and even vaginal bleeding, can be very similar to those experienced in cases of IBS. These overlapping symptoms make it challenging for clinicians to distinguish between a benign digestive disorder and the more serious condition of ovarian cancer without thorough investigations, including imaging and biopsy. Awareness of this similarity is crucial to ensure that ovarian cancer is diagnosed in its early stages when treatment can be most effective.
